headlines.content: # Silver Bullet Mines Details Historical Data on New Arizona Assets and Announces Board Change. The latest announcement is out from Silver Bullet Mines Corp ( (TSE:SBMI) ). Silver Bullet Mines has released historical technical data relating to its recently acquired Columbia and Gold Queen mines in Gila County, Arizona, which lie roughly 30 miles from its Globe mill and support its hub-and-spoke operating strategy. Silver Bullet also reported the resignation of director John MacKenzie, who is focusing on another mining venture, marking a board change as the company advances its Arizona growth strategy. The most recent analyst rating on (TSE:SBMI) stock is a Hold with a C$0.21 price target. Silver Bullet also reported the resignation of director John MacKenzie, who is focusing on another mining venture, marking a board change as the company advances its Arizona growth strategy. The most recent analyst rating on (TSE:SBMI) stock is a Hold with a C$0.21 price target. headlines.content: # South India Paper Mills Limited Files SEBI Certificate for Q4FY26 Under Regulation 74(5). South India Paper Mills Limited has submitted its mandatory certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for Q4FY26, confirming compliance with depository regulations. KFin Technologies Limited certified that details of securities dematerialized and rematerialized during Q4FY26 have been furnished to all stock exchanges where South India Paper Mills Limited shares are listed. # South India Paper Mills Reports Turnaround with ₹237.27 Lakhs Profit in Q3FY26. South India Paper Mills achieved a significant turnaround in Q3FY26 with net profit of ₹237.27 lakhs against previous year's loss of ₹332.80 lakhs. South India Paper Mills  Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 31st December 2025, demonstrating a remarkable turnaround in profitability.

Silver Bullet Mines has released historical technical data relating to its recently acquired Columbia and Gold Queen mines in Gila County, Arizona, which lie roughly 30 miles from its Globe mill and support its hub-and-spoke operating strategy. Silver Bullet also reported the resignation of director John MacKenzie, who is focusing on another mining venture, marking a board change as the company advances its Arizona growth strategy. The most recent analyst rating on (TSE:SBMI) stock is a Hold with a C$0.21 price target. To see the full list of analyst forecasts on Silver Bullet Mines Corp stock, see the TSE:SBMI Stock Forecast page. **Spark’s Take on SBMI Stock**. headlines.content: # St Barbara Wins Key Permit Approval to Restart Touquoy Gold Operations in Nova Scotia. * St Barbara gained permit approvals to restart Touquoy gold processing by late 2026, backed by early refurbishment spending. * Discover top-performing stock ideas and upgrade to a portfolio of market leaders with  Smart Investor Picks. headlines.content: # PSA Marine Receives 16th Z-Tech 6000 Tug. In 2024, Cheoy Lee Shipyards of Hong Kong delivered the first boat of Robert Allan Ltd.’s new *Z-Tech 6000*design, the*PSA Gemini,*to PSA Marine of Singapore. They add to the fleet of more than 100 of the award-winning Z-Tech designs already in service around the world with various tug operators in different ports. Equipped with Niigata 6L28HX medium speed engines rated at 1654 kW, driving 2.3 m Niigata ZP-31B Z-drives, the vessel achieved a bollard pull of 63.6 tons and a top speed of 12.4 knots on trials. The vessel is equipped with a towing winch on the forward working deck, with a deck crane and dual anchor windlasses aft. The bulwarks and fendering have been specifically tailored to PSA Marine’s operations with considerations for towline and fender wear while assisting vessels ranging from containerships to low freeboard barges. To date, PSA Marine has taken delivery of 61 tugs designed by Robert Allan Ltd., including 32 Z-Tech tugs.

headlines.content: # UDT 2026: Aeromaritime details AT7000 antenna system for submarine communications. Aeromaritime's AT-7000 Series submarine communications and SIGINT antenna, displayed at UDT 2026. German maritime communications company Aeromaritime told *Janes* about the development of its AT-7000 series submarine antenna, at Clarion Defence's Undersea Defence Technology (UDT) 2026 exhibition, held in London from 14-16 April. The AT-7000 series replaces Aeromaritime's earlier 4000 series submarine antennas. “With this generation, we can not only do communication, we can also do ELINT [electronic intelligence], COMMINT [communications intelligence] and SIGINT [signals intelligence],” he explained, highlighting the antenna's ability to support both communications and electromagnetic sensing functions at extended ranges. Kivu Bioscience to Present Preclinical Data on Next-Generation ADC Programs at AACR Annual Meeting 2026 - BioSpace
headlines.content: # Kivu Bioscience to Present Preclinical Data on Next-Generation ADC Programs at AACR Annual Meeting 2026. * Clinical-stage PTK7 ADC KIVU-107 shows strong preclinical anti-tumor activity, favorable pharmacokinetics and improved tolerability. * Next-generation CEACAM5 ADC KIVU-305 demonstrates potent preclinical activity and enhanced stability across colorectal and other solid tumor models. SAN MATEO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--#AACR26--Kivu Bioscience, a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for difficult-to-treat cancers, today announced upcoming poster presentations at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting 2026, held April 17–22, in San Diego. Our second program, KIVU-305, expands our reach into CEACAM5, reinforcing our ability to develop differentiated ADCs with improved stability, tolerability and anti-tumor activity.”. Title: KIVU-107: a clinical-stage, best-in-class PTK7 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) with favorable PK and an improved tolerability profile. Title: Preclinical efficacy and safety of KIVU-305, a novel CEACAM5-targeting antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for colorectal cancer. **About Kivu Bioscience**Kivu Bioscience is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for oncology.

headlines.title: Alethio Therapeutics Unveils ATX‑011, a Breakthrough, Mutation‑Agnostic Antibody for Treating Essential Thrombocythemia – a c.$2B Market, and Strengthens Leadership to Accelerate Path to IND - BioSpace
headlines.content: **Oxford, UK – 16th April 2026** - Alethio Therapeutics, a biopharmaceutical company developing novel treatments for myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN), today announced the unveiling of ATX‑011, a first‑in‑class, mutation‑agnostic antibody with potential to disrupt the $2B Essential Thrombocythemia (ET) market. Through Alethio’s ARTEMIS target‑discovery and development engine, the Company identified a surface target that enables selective removal of platelets and the mutant stem/progenitor cells that drive excess platelet production – independent of the patient’s driver mutation – and orthogonally validated this target using samples from more than 80 MPN patients. The Company is also advancing a programme targeting mutant CALR – a key driver mutation in MPNs. Alethio Therapeutics’ pipeline is powered by its proprietary ARTEMIS discovery and development engine, which integrates access to leading MPN biobanks, single-cell sequencing, organoids, and bioinformatics to de-risk first-in-human trials and identify new mutant drivers, expanding therapeutic reach and market potential.

headlines.title: AACR 2026: First‑in‑Human STC‑1010 Data Show Favorable Safety and Early Immune Engagement in Metastatic MSS Colorectal Cancer - BioSpace
headlines.content: # AACR 2026: First‑in‑Human STC‑1010 Data Show Favorable Safety and Early Immune Engagement in Metastatic MSS Colorectal Cancer. LYON, France--(BUSINESS WIRE)--#Biotech--Brenus Pharma announced that new first‑in‑human data will be presented at the **AACR Annual Meeting 2026** (April 17–22, San Diego, California). headlines.title: Navy League 2026: Collins Aerospace continues to roll out TCTS II air combat training system, eyes new customers - Janes
headlines.content: # Navy League 2026: Collins Aerospace continues to roll out TCTS II air combat training system, eyes new customers. Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, continues to roll out its Tactical Combat Training System Increment II (TCTS II) for the US Navy and Marine Corps, Kate Gabel, general manager for multi-domain solutions for Collins Aerospace, told *Janes* on 16 April ahead of the Navy League Sea-Air-Space 2026 exhibition from 20-22 April. TCTS II is a live, virtual, constructive (LVC) training system that presents a threat environment to the pilot “that is real world to them in the cockpit”, Gabel said. The integration of cryptography and Multiple Independent Levels of Security (MILS) is meant to ensure “the right data gets to the right folks, but it still gives that holistic picture and doesn't disallow certain levels of data to be part of the common operational picture as part of the training exercise and information [provided] to the pilots”, she explained.

headlines.title: Toshiba Starts Sample Shipments of New “SmartMCD™” Series Product Integrating Microcontroller and Motor Driver - Financial Times
headlines.content: KAWASAKI, Japan--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 15, 2026-- Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation (“Toshiba”) has started to ship engineering samples of “TB9M030FG,” the latest addition to its “SmartMCD™”[1] series of motor control devices. The new device integrates a microcontroller (MCU) and a motor driver, and incorporates sensorless control technology for low‑speed operation of three‑phase brushless DC motors. Toshiba: TB9M030FG, the latest product in the Smart Motor Control Driver “SmartMCD™” series. TB9M030FG integrates an Arm® Cortex®‑M0 core-based MCU, flash memory, a gate driver that controls and drives N‑channel power MOSFETs for three‑phase brushless DC motor operation, a local interconnect network (LIN)[5] transceiver, and a power system that can operate at automotive battery levels—all in a small 9×9mm (typ.) QFP48 package. Toshiba’s sensorless control technology developed for low‑speed operation enables position‑sensorless FOC control from zero speed through low speeds when used with salient‑pole motors[6]. | [1] | Smart MCD: A series of automotive motor control drivers (MCDs) developed by Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation that integrate a motor driver and a microcontroller into a single device.

headlines.title: Serial-to-IP Converter Flaws Expose OT and Healthcare Systems to Hacking - SecurityWeek
headlines.content: **Serial-to-IP converters are affected by potentially serious vulnerabilities that can expose operational technology (OT), healthcare, and other types of systems to remote attacks.**. Serial-to-IP converters, also known as serial device servers, are hardware devices that bridge legacy serial equipment to modern Ethernet/IP networks, allowing old industrial control systems (ICS) and other OT devices to communicate remotely. Researchers at network security and threat detection company Forescout Technologies have analyzed these devices and found numerous vulnerabilities that could be valuable to threat actors. In addition to internet-exposed devices, attackers could target serial-to-IP converters on local networks, which can be compromised via vulnerabilities or misconfigurations in edge devices such as routers and firewalls. Forescout’s research, which focused on Silex and Lantronix devices, led to the discovery of 20 new vulnerabilities across the two vendors’ products, including weaknesses that can be exploited without authentication. headlines.title: Raytheon lands $3.7bn Patriot GEM‑T contract for Ukraine - Army Technology
headlines.content: Raytheon has finalised a contract valued at $3.7bn to supply Ukraine with Patriot Guidance Enhanced Missile-Tactical (GEM-T) interceptors. The contract involves the delivery of the Patriot Advanced Capability-2 (PAC-2) GEM-T, one of the main effectors used in the Patriot missile defence system. Patriot GEM-T is designed to neutralise airborne threats including tactical ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and hostile aircraft. Owned by COMLOG, a joint venture between Raytheon and MBDA Deutschland, the site will serve this contract as well as additional agreements, supporting supply chain stability and aiding the replenishment of Ukraine’s stock of interceptors. The contract with Ukraine comes closely after Raytheon signed a $627m deal to supply the Netherlands with additional Patriot air and missile defence system equipment. The Patriot air and missile defence system combines radar sensors, command-and-control capabilities, and several interceptor variants to work as an integrated network that can detect, classify, and engage tactical ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, drones, advanced aircraft, and other aerial threats.

headlines.content: The problem, reports OX Security, is what it terms an architectural flaw in Anthropic’s MCP code embedded within most of these local STDIO MCPs. In a nutshell, OX Security says this flaw can result in a complete adversarial takeover over the user’s computer system. Eventually, the only apparent action from Anthropic was to quietly update its security guidance to recommend MCP adapters be used ‘with caution’ – “leaving the flaw intact and shifting responsibility to developers”. The OX report on its findings includes details on how Anthropic could solve the problem by deprecating unsanitized STDIO connections, introducing protocol level command sandboxing, including a ‘dangerous mode’ explicit opt-in, and developing marketplace verification standards to include a standardized security manifest. **Related**: Anthropic MCP Server Flaws Lead to Code Execution, Data Exposure. headlines.title: Emerson Launches Innovative Software-Driven Method for High-Fidelity Aerospace RF Testing - SpaceNews
headlines.content: NI CHESS enables flexible software-driven, lab-based RF validation to reduce costs and risks of field testing. AUSTIN, Texas (April 13, 2026) – Emerson announced the NI Channel Emulator System Software (CHESS) platform today at the 2026 Space Symposium conference in Colorado, introducing a new software-defined approach that enables aerospace and defense teams to validate mission-critical radio frequency (RF) links entirely in the lab—without the cost, risk or logistics of traditional field testing. Unlike traditional test methods constrained by simplified channel approximations, NI CHESS delivers realistic RF behavior emulation and adapts as systems grow in complexity. NI CHESS gives engineers a practical way to validate mission-critical RF performance early and often using true-to-life conditions in the lab so teams can move faster, reduce risk and control costs without compromising realism,” said Chris Behnke, director for aerospace and defense RF test and validation systems at Emerson. To learn more about the NI Channel Emulator System Software and how it can help move RF testing from the field into the lab, visit www.ni.com/CHESS.

The IRS just reset the ERC clock: Six months or file suit - Accounting Today
headlines.content: The IRS announced a streamlined process for Employee Retention Credit claimants to extend the two-year deadline to file a refund suit after a claim disallowance. Under existing law, the IRS and a taxpayer can agree in writing to extend the time to file suit if both parties sign Form 907 before the two-year period expires. A countersigned Form 907 gives the IRS more time to consider the disallowance and gives the taxpayer more time to file suit if the case does not resolve. The most common errors are a name or Employer Identification Number mismatch with the disallowance letter; the wrong tax type or tax period on Form 907; a missing taxpayer signature where required; a representative not covered by a valid Form 2848; and assuming submission equals protection without an IRS countersignature before the two-year date.

Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly - The Business of Fashion
headlines.content: # Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly. Indian fashion and beauty giant Reliance Retail has acquired Anomaly, the hair care brand founded by actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas, *The Business of Beauty* can exclusively reveal. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

headlines.title: Reliance sees oil shock impact in Q4 earnings, analyst expects recovery ahead - CNBC
headlines.content: Monday - Friday, 11:00 - 12:00 SIN/HK | 0500 - 06:00 CET. # Reliance sees oil shock impact in Q4 earnings, analyst expects recovery ahead. headlines.title: China pledges self-reliance, energy independence - Semafor
headlines.content: Intelligence for the New World Economy. Intelligence for the New World Economy. In your inbox, every weekday. # China pledges self-reliance, energy independence. Apr 28, 2026, 7:45am EDT. Top Chinese leaders pledged to accelerate the country’s self-reliance and energy independence in the wake of the Iran war. The announcement, following this month’s meeting of the Politburo of the Communist Party, prioritized the “construction of water, power, and computing infrastructure,” the South China Morning Post said. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

headlines.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas’s Anomaly Enters New Phase With Reliance Retail Acquisition - WWD
headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly - The Business of Fashion
headlines.content: # Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly. Indian fashion and beauty giant Reliance Retail has acquired Anomaly, the hair care brand founded by actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas, *The Business of Beauty* can exclusively reveal. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. headlines.content: Monday - Friday, 11:00 - 12:00 SIN/HK | 0500 - 06:00 CET. # Reliance sees oil shock impact in Q4 earnings, analyst expects recovery ahead. Vivekanand Subbaraman of Ambit Capital says the near-term outlook for Reliance’s refining and oil-to-chemicals business remains challenging, as Indian refiners face sharply higher crude and input costs due to disruptions in Middle East supplies. However, he expects conditions to improve after the Iran war, with logistics normalizing and Middle East players likely shifting focus back to upstream operations.

headlines.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas’s Anomaly Enters New Phase With Reliance Retail Acquisition - WWD
headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

Vivekanand Subbaraman of Ambit Capital says the near-term outlook for Reliance’s refining and oil-to-chemicals business remains challenging, as Indian refiners face sharply higher crude and input costs due to disruptions in Middle East supplies. However, he expects conditions to improve after the Iran war, with logistics normalizing and Middle East players likely shifting focus back to upstream operations.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

headlines.content: # Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly. Indian fashion and beauty giant Reliance Retail has acquired Anomaly, the hair care brand founded by actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas, *The Business of Beauty* can exclusively reveal. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.
headlines.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas’s Anomaly Enters New Phase With Reliance Retail Acquisition - WWD

headlines.content: # Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly. Indian fashion and beauty giant Reliance Retail has acquired Anomaly, the hair care brand founded by actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas, *The Business of Beauty* can exclusively reveal. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.
headlines.title: Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly - The Business of Fashion

Apr 28, 2026, 7:45am EDT. Top Chinese leaders pledged to accelerate the country’s self-reliance and energy independence in the wake of the Iran war. The announcement, following this month’s meeting of the Politburo of the Communist Party, prioritized the “construction of water, power, and computing infrastructure,” the South China Morning Post said. Beijing has been somewhat insulated from the conflict’s fallout thanks to its oil stockpile and aggressive push for renewables, but experts say it could be squeezed as a result of slowdowns in its key export markets. A protracted shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz in particular could force Chinese authorities to roll out fiscal or monetary support, a leading economist told Reuters.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.
headlines.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas’s Anomaly Enters New Phase With Reliance Retail Acquisition - WWD

headlines.content: # Reliance Retail Acquires Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ Hair Care Brand Anomaly. Indian fashion and beauty giant Reliance Retail has acquired Anomaly, the hair care brand founded by actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas, *The Business of Beauty* can exclusively reveal. Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

Reliance Retail’s executive director Isha Ambani said in a statement that the retailer would be leveraging its omnichannel capabilities to scale Anomaly in India, citing the brand’s focus on Indian hair and scalp needs as a “key driver.” Reliance owns the beauty retailer Tira, which operates 28 stores across India, a network that will be used to accelerate Anomaly’s growth. Reliance Retail is India’s largest retailer by revenue, and has recently doubled down on its efforts to scale brands as competitors like Nykaa, which owns Katrina Kaif’s Kay and is rumoured to be buying Deepika Padukone’s line 82°E, battle for share of the domestic beauty market. *India’s largest retailer has acquired Himalayan skincare brand Pahadi Local amid a global surge in demand for Indian beauty and wellness.*.

headlines.content: **MUMBAI, India** — Making its first global beauty acquisition, Reliance Retail Ltd. on Thursday revealed it has purchased Priyanka Chopra Jonas’ hair care brand Anomaly. The move signals both an expansion of Reliance Retail’s ambitions and a new chapter for a brand that has built its identity around clean, accessible beauty. With the acquisition, Anomaly is expected to accelerate growth by leveraging its global brand equity alongside Reliance’s market expertise, retail scale and omnichannel capabilities. Speaking to WWD at the launch of Anomaly in India in August 2022, Chopra Jonas noted the fast-changing beauty segment in India with a “democratized access to beauty and personal care,” describing the Indian market as “dynamic and evolving, with both women and men showing growing interest in personal care products.”. The acquisition aligns with Reliance Retail’s broader strategy to deepen its footprint in beauty as the Indian market continues to expand rapidly. Earlier this month, the company launched Fenty Beauty and Fenty Skin in India through an exclusive partnership, further strengthening its portfolio of international brands.

headlines.title: Prudential Norms on Specified Non-financial Assets (SNFA) Directions
headlines.content:
Regulated entities (REs) are, in normal course, not expected to come into possession of non-financial assets in lieu of their regular lending operations. However, in exceptional cases, where the exposures become non-performing and legal or contractual remedies have been invoked, REs may, as part of recovery strategy, acquire ownership of an immovable asset furnished as collateral security. A controlled and timely disposal of such asset, on an arm’s-length basis, may enable the RE to maximise net recoveries while ensuring transparency and prudence in the recovery process.

2. To provide clarity on prudential treatment of such assets, (hereinafter called as ‘Specified Non-financial Assets’ (SNFAs)), the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has today issued the draft ‘Prudential Norms on Specified Non-financial Assets Directions’ for public comments.

3. The following salient features have been incorporated in the draft Directions:

  1. Only exposures classified as non-performing, in respect of which other recovery options have been explored and assessed to be unviable, shall be eligible for extinguishment in terms of these Directions.

  2. REs may acquire SNFAs in lieu of full or partial extinguishment of their claims against the borrower.

  3. In cases involving partial extinguishment of claims, the residual exposure shall be treated as restructured and shall be subject to the applicable prudential requirements.

  4. The SNFAs shall be recorded and carried at the lower of the Net Book Value (NBV) of the extinguished exposure or the distress sale value of the SNFA.

  5. At each subsequent reporting date, SNFA shall be carried at the lower of last available distress sale value or the revised NBV, which shall be net of notional provisions, had the exposure continued on the books of the RE.

  6. With a view to ensuring timely disposal of such SNFAs, a maximum holding period of seven years has been prescribed.

  7. To mitigate moral hazard, REs shall be prohibited from selling the SNFA back to the borrower or to any related party of the borrower.

  8. REs shall be required to disclose the stock of SNFAs held by them in their balance sheet.

4. The comments on the draft guidelines are invited from public / stakeholders by May 26, 2026. The comments / feedback may be submitted through the link under the ‘Connect2Regulate’ Section available on the Reserve Bank’s website. Comments may alternatively be forwarded to The Chief General Manager, Credit Risk Group, Department of Regulation, Central Office, Reserve Bank of India, 12th / 13th Floor, Shahid Bhagat Singh Marg, Fort, Mumbai – 400 001 or by email.

(Brij Raj)           
Chief General Manager

Press Release: 2026-2027/208
